summary: Back in after 2.5 hours of snow blowing and shoveling. Wanted to say thank you to @vconnecting for being so inclusive to scholars with children. Had a snow day doing my last two sessions and everyone was super supportive. We need this type of hospitality. It isn't radical it's inclusive.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Back in after 2.5 hours of snow blowing and shoveling. Wanted to say thank you to @vconnecting for being so inclusive to scholars with children. Had a snow day doing my last two sessions and everyone was super supportive. We need this type of hospitality. It isn't radical it's inclusive.
